desc: Free-standing pressure-treated wood pergola with straight double beams, open rafters, and black metal post bases bolted to distinct square concrete piers set among a Florida paver patio.
reuse_notes: Use for pergolas, outdoor posts, concrete-pier support context, deck and patio structures, exterior framing, and storm-ready connector articles. It depicts a generic free-standing assembly, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for site-specific footing, wind-load, setback, or permit requirements.
